resources.name: Foodbank NSW & ACT
resources.costNote: Free food-help locator; partner eligibility and access rules vary
resources.summary: A food-relief network connecting people in New South Wales and the ACT with local charity partners.
resources.availabilityNote: The warehouse is not a guaranteed public pantry. Use the official find-food pathway to contact a local charity.
resources.sourceDetail: Foodbank Australia's official finder directs people to state services and local food-relief partners.

resources.name: Wayside Chapel Kings Cross
resources.costNote: Free showers, toiletries, emergency clothing, and support
resources.hours: Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–9:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM–4:00 PM; Sunday 9:00 AM–3:00 PM
resources.summary: Showers, emergency clothing, housing and crisis-accommodation referrals, clinics, and a safe community space.
resources.availabilityNote: Wayside's community services are open daily, but clinics and specific support have schedules. Confirm before travel.
resources.sourceDetail: The official programs page lists the Kings Cross address and its community-service-centre support.

resources.name: Wayside Chapel Bondi
resources.costNote: Free showers, toiletries, emergency clothing, and support
resources.summary: A welcoming community centre with showers, toiletries, emergency clothing, support, activities, and scheduled clinics.
resources.availabilityNote: Open weekdays; clinic and activity schedules vary. Review the official Bondi page before travel.
resources.sourceDetail: Wayside's official Bondi page lists the address, opening times, and basic necessities available.

resources.availabilityNote: Day rest is daytime support, not an overnight bed. Visiting services and emergency-relief approval vary. The provider says email and web enquiries are not checked regularly; phone for current access details.
resources.costNote: Free showers, clothing support, and service navigation
resources.eligibility: Emergency financial relief has catchment and eligibility rules. Call to check your area; eligible visitors need an appointment with a support worker, their latest Centrelink statement and copies of overdue bills.
resources.hours: Centre: daily 8:30am to 4pm. Cafe: daily 8:30am to 2pm, Brisbane local time.
resources.name: 3rd Space
resources.sourceDetail: Official contact and services pages confirm daily centre and cafe hours, emergency-relief catchment and appointment requirements, and the warning that email and web enquiries are not checked regularly. These access details were checked October 12, 2026. The original broader review date and cost claims are retained, not newly verified.
resources.summary: A seven-day drop-in center with hot showers, clothing and emergency relief, a safe place to rest, and housing navigation.

resources.name: Ask Izzy
resources.summary: A free, anonymous service finder for housing, food, health care, counselling, safety, money help, clothing, showers, and other everyday needs.
resources.availabilityNote: Available online. Contact a listed provider to confirm eligibility, capacity, hours, and access before travel.
resources.sourceDetail: Ask Izzy's official search covers housing, food, health, counselling, safety, and everyday-needs services across Australia.

resources.costNote: Free to search; provider rules vary
resources.name: Orange Sky Service Locator

resources.sourceDetail: Orange Sky's official site describes free mobile laundry and shower services across Australia.

resources.address: Nationwide telephone service covering all of Australia
resources.availabilityNote: Registered nurses provide advice 24/7. Mobile call charges may apply. Use the official page for interpreter and relay access. This is not an emergency-response service.
resources.costNote: Free to call and free to use, though call charges may apply from mobiles
resources.coverageNote: Coverage area: Nationwide telephone service covering all of Australia. The map marker is geographic context, not a single service address.
resources.eligibility: Health advice and local-service navigation for people in Australia. The published 1800 number is a domestic access route; overseas dialing is not confirmed.
resources.hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
resources.name: healthdirect
services: After-hours GP call back or video call
resources.sourceDetail: The official help page lists 1800 022 222, 24/7 nursing advice, possible mobile call charges, and interpreter and relay access. These access details were checked October 12, 2026. The page labels its own review September 2023; RWN has not treated that as an October 2026 publication date. The original broader review date is retained.
resources.sourceKind: Official service locator or guidance page
resources.summary: Healthdirect is a free, government-funded 24-hour health advice line for all Australians. It provides access to registered nurses who can offer health advice, assess symptoms, and direct callers to appropriate local care.
resources.verifiedQuote: "healthdirect Australia is a free service where you can talk to a nurse or doctor who can help you know what to do."

resources.name: Find a water refill station

resources.summary: Sydney Water provides a map of permanent water refill stations across Greater Sydney. The service allows anyone to easily find locations to refill their water bottles with safe, clean drinking water.
resources.availabilityNote: Permanent water refill stations located across Greater Sydney. Users should bring their own refillable bottle.
resources.sourceKind: Official service locator or guidance page
resources.sourceDetail: The official Sydney Water website provides a map to find permanent water refill stations across Greater Sydney for free hydration.
resources.verifiedQuote: "Search for your nearest water refill station for easy access to safe, clean, free water."
